Definition: to pinch sycamore figs (a process necessary to ripen them)
BiblicalUsage: Amos says he was no prophet and no prophet's son, but a herdsman and a gatherer of sycomore fruit, and this is the word for that gathering work, pinching the figs so they ripen.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God delights to call ordinary working men, and Amos's figs are proof that He does not need a title before He speaks.
